data.title: Muster Bank asks you to update your customer data (Geldwäschegesetz)
data.summary: Muster Bank AG asks David Muster to send a copy of his valid ID and the completed self-disclosure form (Selbstauskunftsbogen) within 8 working days of the letter's date (18 December 2025), as required under the Anti-Money Laundering Act (Geldwäschegesetz). If the documents are not received in time, the bank says it must block the custody account (Depot) for purchases until the matter is clarified.
data.explanation: This is a routine identity-verification request that German banks must make periodically under anti-money-laundering law. You need to send a copy of your valid ID and the filled-out self-disclosure form to the bank. If you miss the deadline shown by the app, the bank says it will block your securities account for new purchases until you provide the documents. This letter is dated 18 December 2025 and a long time has passed since then, so check whether you already sent these documents or whether the account is currently blocked, and contact the bank if unsure.
